//: Compiler settings are deliberately aligned with pedigree-insights, because src/vendor/
holds verbatim copies of its modules and they must typecheck here exactly as they do
there. A stricter flag on this side would force edits to vendored files — which is the
drift the vendoring exists to prevent. If a flag is worth adding, add it in
pedigree-insights first, fix the source, then re-sync.
Differences from the source config are only those that follow from this being a Node
and Workers project rather than an Electron/React one: no DOM lib, no jsx.
